text:
Olivia Tan: dropping notes from today's onboarding with Clearwater. they gave three solid asks for product to triage.
Ben Koh: thanks Olivia. paste the asks and any direct quotes.
Olivia Tan: 1) A per-project forecast card that shows projected monthly spend if current usage continues. 2) Option to mark embeddings as 'shared' between projects to avoid duplicate compute. 3) Better onboarding docs for quota and best-practices (customers keep hitting soft limits).
Riley Martinez: quote from CSM: 'we're getting blindsided by spikes and it's blocking budgeting meetings.'
Zara Ahmed: technical note: shared embeddings map looks similar to our internal dedupe feature but needs cross-project keys + RBAC concerns. that'll need design review.
Ben Koh: prioritization suggested: forecast card = P1 (reduces renewal friction), shared embeddings = P2 (cost saver), docs/workshop = P1 (low effort, high impact).
Olivia Tan: they showed an example job that runs nightly indexing and then a separate team runs similarity search, causing duplicate embeddings. sample: nightly-indexer@projectA -> embeds doc set; search-service@projectB -> embeds same docs.
Riley Martinez: proposed interim workaround: CS can run a weekly reuse script that dedupes embeddings for them and report savings. but they'd prefer platform-level control.
Zara Ahmed: engineering estimate: forecast card MVP = 1 backend sprint to compute linear projection + 1 frontend sprint for UI. shared embeddings cross-project = 3 sprints due to access controls and storage changes. onboarding docs + quick live workshop = 3-4 days.
Ben Koh: action items: (1) Olivia to send the sample job JSONs and permission matrix. (2) I'll open a product ticket for Forecast Card (tag P1) and link this thread. (3) Zara to draft a technical approach for shared embeddings and list RBAC risks. (4) CS to schedule a short workshop next week for Clearwater.
ops-bot: Reminder set 1 business days to follow up on Forecast Card ticket.
Olivia Tan: thanks team, I'll upload recordings and the sample datasets to the shared folder. :thumbsup:
Riley Martinez: I'll volunteer to run the interim dedupe script once we have access to their sample exports.
Zara Ahmed: starting a draft spec today, will post to the ticket.
Ben Koh: keeping an eye on this as a renewal-sensitive pilot. will loop in finance if needed.
Olivia Tan: end of thread.
